subject: POC deliverables and milestone-linked discount — clarification
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara@orchidhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify POC scope and milestone-linked discount

Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited by the latency and cost profile you showed. Before we move to an SOW I need a couple of clarifications so our procurement and engineering teams can green-light the pilot:  

1) Deliverables: Can you confirm the measurable deliverables for the 6-week POC (examples: integration support hours, throughput target, sample evals delivered)? We want these spelled out so we can map internal signoffs.

2) Discount structure: Your team mentioned a "milestone-linked" conversion discount. Does that mean the discount applies only if specified POC milestones are met? If so, how is "met" defined and how long does the discount apply post-conversion?

3) Unused capacity: If we purchase a 2-week burst pack as part of the POC and don’t use it, does that convert to credits for the paid contract, or are hours forfeited?

We have procurement on the thread (procurement@orchidhealth.com) — they prefer a short SOW + DocuSign flow.

Appreciate a concise response so we can move forward this month.

Best,
Sara Khan
Head of ML Platforms
Orchid Health

--
Attachments: none

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify POC scope and milestone-linked discount

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Below are concrete answers and a short attachment pack (SOW + pricing grid).

1) Deliverables (6-week POC):
- Week 0–1: Onboarding & infra prep (account, data mapping, test dataset ingest).
- Week 2–4: Integration + model tuning (one dedicated day of eng time/week from Redwood + access to Dedicated trial pool).
- Week 4–5: Evaluation: performance benchmarks (p50/p90/p99 latency, token-cost per inference) and accuracy checks on your eval set (we’ll run your eval suite).
- Week 6: Handover + conversion plan (runbook, recommended config).

2) Milestone-linked discount: proposed approach (terms in attached POC_SOW_v2.pdf):
- Milestone A (integration + baseline eval delivered) => 7.5% conversion discount off first-year list price if customer signs within 60 days.
- Milestone B (final benchmarks achieved: p99 <= 200ms and cost/unit improvement >= 20%) => additional 7.5% (stacking to 15% total) on first-year invoice.
- Definition of "met": we capture objective test runs (hashes + run logs) and both parties sign-off in a short acceptance note.
- Discount applies to invoices for months 1–12 after conversion (first paid contract).

3) Unused capacity: default is to convert unused paid POC hours to a Redwood credit balance usable against the first 90 days of the converted contract (credits expire 90 days after conversion). We can negotiate a different window on enterprise deals but 90 days is standard for pilots.

Next steps: I attached POC_SOW_v2.pdf and redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx. If that looks good I can send the SOW for signature (DocuSign) and loop in our Solutions Engineer for an onboarding slot next week.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachments: POC_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara@orchidhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify POC scope and milestone-linked discount

Adding a couple of practical notes from AE playbook — happy to adjust if you prefer the original structure:  

- Alternative to stacking discounts: offer a convertible credit equal to 10% of billed POC spend that applies to the first 3 invoices post-conversion. This keeps accounting simple for procurement while giving you a measurable financial incentive.
- Success metric suggestion: make the benchmark run reproducible (we keep the run logs + seed) so there's no ambiguity when we validate p99 and cost improvements.
- Unused hours: if Orchid prefers, we can do a one-time rollover of up to 25% of unused hours into a 6-month credit (instead of the 90-day policy) — requires procurement sign-off.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the SOW.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--

From: Michael Thompson <michael@orchidhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Sara Khan <sara@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify POC scope and milestone-linked discount

Thanks Diego/Priyom — this is helpful. A couple of procurement/legal clarifications before we sign:  

1) Can you add a short clause to the SOW that explicitly states how unused hours convert to credits and the credit expiry window? Procurement wants a one-paragraph clause to include in our PO.
2) Discount mechanics: we need the discount to be visible on the first invoice line item (so internal finance can reconcile). Does Redwood show the conversion discount as an invoice-level credit?
3) Discount period: can you confirm that the discount applies to months 1–12 post-conversion (as Diego suggested) and not prorated?

Attaching our standard PO terms for reference (Orchid_PO_Terms.pdf). Procurement contact is procurement@orchidhealth.com — they’ll respond if there are redlines.

-Michael Thompson
Director, Procurement
Orchid Health

--

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Michael Thompson <michael@orchidhealth.com>, Sara Khan <sara@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify POC scope and milestone-linked discount

Michael/Sara — appreciate the questions. Final confirmations below (I’ll push an updated SOW and a one-paragraph clause to remove ambiguity):

1) Unused hours clause (to be added to SOW): "Any prepaid POC hours not consumed during the POC will convert to Redwood Service Credits at the prevailing POC rate. Such credits will be available for use against invoices for the first 90 days following contract conversion. Parties may mutually agree in writing to an alternate conversion window prior to signature."

2) Discount mechanics: Redwood will show the conversion discount as an invoice-level credit line on the first invoice after conversion. We can also annotate the invoice description with the relevant milestone IDs and acceptance note references for your reconciliation.

3) Discount period: confirmed — discount applies to months 1–12 post-conversion and is not prorated across months (it will be shown as a percentage credit against the invoice schedule for the first year).

Next steps: I’ll attach the one-paragraph unused-hours clause into POC_SOW_v2 and resend for signature via DocuSign (link below). Once signed we’ll schedule a kickoff with Solutions Eng for the week starting May 24.
